title: Boots without crashing, prints to serial
goal: Start normally after power-on and print something to serial
pass: No panic / abort within 3 s, at least 1 line of serial output
brief:
Write firmware for Seeed XIAO ESP32C3 (ESP32-C3) with ESP-IDF 5.x.
Goal: Start normally after power-on and print something to serial
Wiring:
- DHT11 DATA: GPIO5 (open drain, 10 kΩ pull-up on the module)
Pass condition: No panic / abort within 3 s, at least 1 line of serial output
Submit only flash.bin (merged image, starting at 0x0).

title: DHT11 reading
goal: Read the DHT11 with your own single-wire driver and print temperature and humidity to serial
pass: Serial prints "温度 <°C> 湿度 <%RH>" matching the environment (23.5 °C ±1, 45 %RH ±1)
